About Synthetic Robotics Testco

Founded in 2015, we are an engineering company based in Dubai Silicon Oasis. Our in-house engineering team of 25 engineers designs robotic arms, sensors integration and control systems.

We use SolidWorks for mechanical design and keep a detailed bill of materials for every robotic cell we build.

Our quality process is certified to ISO 9001 and every cell goes through documented inspection and test reports before delivery.

We have around 40 employees across engineering, production and support.
